arg.name: map
arg.description: Map name (folder in stack_master/maps/)

arg.name: sim
arg.description: Use simulator (true) or real hardware (false)

arg.name: localization
arg.description: gt (sim) | cartographer | pf (real)

arg.name: virtual
arg.description: Inject virtual opponent/obstacles (scan overlay etc.); on by default in sim, off on the real car

arg.name: opp_spawn
arg.description: (virtual) spawn the kinematic opponent at startup on the map centerline; otherwise spawn it with RViz 2D Goal Pose or stack_master/scripts/spawn_opponent.py

arg.name: opp_mode
arg.description: (virtual) opponent driving mode: manual | path (pure-pursuit on the centerline at a constant speed -- deterministic, use for regression runs) | ftg (reactive from its own lidar)

arg.name: reopt
arg.description: Obstacle-aware global line: run static_reopt_node + static_obstacle_layer instead of the plain global_trajectory_publisher (IFAC static-obstacle re-optimization)

arg.name: reopt_safety_width
arg.description: safety_width for the obstacle-aware re-optimizer (incl. car width). NB: the tight ifac centerline only solves plain mincurv_iqp at 0.25 or lower

arg.name: reopt_obs_change_tol
arg.description: min obstacle move [m] to re-trigger the re-opt QP (larger = detection jitter does not thrash it). Bounded ABOVE by the margin chain: the line is built to reopt_obs_margin (0.35) and the SM calls it blocked below gb_ego_width_m/2 + lateral_width_static_gb_m (0.25), so a drift this tolerance ignores must not eat that 0.10 m of headroom. It was 0.25 — a box could walk 25 cm, take the followed line under the SM requirement, and never re-trigger anything. Verified by stack_master/scripts/check_avoidance_margins.py.

arg.name: reopt_clearance_dirty
arg.description: [m] CONSEQUENCE rebuild trigger: re-optimize as soon as the ACTIVE line's clearance to a box it used to clear falls below this, whatever the box moved. reopt_obs_change_tol only measures the cause. Set at the SM's static requirement (0.25) + slack, i.e. rebuild before the free-check would call the line blocked. Must stay between that requirement and reopt_obs_margin.

arg.name: reopt_compute_sp
arg.description: also re-optimize the shortest_path line (ot_interpolator consumes it); false only if the OT line is unused

arg.name: reopt_method
arg.description: obstacle-aware line optimizer: local_window (fast ONLINE windowed min-curv QP, ms/solve) | global (legacy whole-track mincurv_iqp, minutes/solve, offline-grade)

arg.name: reopt_reach_time
arg.description: [s] DEPRECATED seed for the old speed-scaled reach; the reach is now chosen by a lap-time search over [reach_min, reach_max]. Ignored.

arg.name: reopt_reach_min
arg.description: [m] MIN arc half-width searched. The reach is picked to MINIMISE estimated lap time, not by local speed.

arg.name: reopt_reach_max
arg.description: [m] MAX arc half-width searched. On a short tight track a wide arc is SLOW (ifac: R=10 m costs ~2x the time a reactive line loses); raise only on long open tracks.

arg.name: reopt_qp_veh_width
arg.description: [m] vehicle width for the windowed QP corridor + floor (obstacle clearance is obs_margin, separate)

arg.name: reopt_wall_margin
arg.description: [m] wall reserve of the re-optimized detour. Aligned with the reactive spliner's wall reserve — the recorded apex was DRIVEN at that reserve; a larger value here shrinks the hump below the proven clearance and the all-or-nothing fit rejects it (obstacle stays reactive-only).

arg.name: reopt_obs_margin
arg.description: [m] clearance of the re-optimized line off each obstacle's edge. MUST be >= the reactive keep-out (width_car/2 + safety_margin in static_avoidance_params.yaml, currently 0.30) or the re-opt line sits inside the reactive planner's own keep-out and gets re-avoided every lap. Run stack_master/scripts/check_avoidance_margins.py after tuning either side.

arg.name: reopt_relax_floor
arg.description: [m] lowest clearance a hump may be ACCEPTED at when reopt_obs_margin is unreachable on either side of the box (coverage ladder). Two constraints, and the higher wins: it must be at least the REACTIVE keep-out (width_car/2 + safety_margin = 0.30) so a relaxed hump still clears the box by what the reactive planner would itself have driven, AND it must sit at least 5 cm above every consumer of that clearance -- the reactive clear-gate entry (width_car/2 + clear_margin_m + clear_hyst_m = 0.28) is the binding one. The ladder lands exactly on this floor by construction, so a smaller gap is read by a fail-closed consumer as NOT clear and the line gets re-avoided. 0.33 satisfies both; measured on ifac and map f it costs no coverage at all (identical laid counts and drop reasons vs 0.30). Set equal to reopt_obs_margin to disable the ladder.

arg.name: reopt_apex_merge_gap
arg.description: [m] apex spacing below which two obstacles are treated as ONE cluster by the re-optimizer: same side -> merged into a single hump (weaving back to the raceline between boxes 2 m apart is motion the corridor pays for twice), opposite sides -> dropped as a pair when no reach can swing between them inside the curvature budget. 0 disables the pre-pass.

arg.name: reopt_wall_gate_kernel
arg.description: [cells] erosion kernel of the FINAL wall gate on the re-optimized line: every published point is checked against the map eroded by floor(k/2) cells before the swap is allowed. A published point is a CAR CENTRE, so this must reserve at least half a car -- 7 cells at 0.05 m/px = 0.15 m = width_car/2, matching the reactive planner body_kernel_size. It was 3 (0.05 m), i.e. the line the car follows for every lap after the swap was held to a third of the clearance the reactive planner demands of itself. Never lower it to make a refusal go away: a refusal means a hump the waypoint corridor accepted puts the car body into a wall, and on maps that ship d_left/d_right exchanged this is the only check that can see it. 0 disables the gate.

arg.name: reopt_hold_max_gap
arg.description: [m] widest gap between two SAME-SIDE obstacles the re-optimized line may HOLD its offset across instead of returning to the raceline between them. Returning costs two merge inflections and a speed dip, and buys a stretch of racing line the car leaves again immediately; beyond this gap the stretch is long enough to be worth taking. The held shape is offered to the reach search as an extra CANDIDATE -- the ordinary lap-time ranking still picks the winner. 0 disables it.

arg.name: reopt_hold_kappa_max
arg.description: [1/m] the hold above is only offered where the RACELINE is straight: max |kappa_clean| over the bridged span. In a corner the line between two boxes is the apex, and holding an offset across it gives that away.

arg.name: reopt_fit_tol
arg.description: [m] corridor-fit tolerance of the re-optimizer. The corridor is a smoothed estimate rippling ~2 mm between stations while the amplitude cap parks the hump peak exactly on it, so a zero tolerance rejects every wide reach over a sub-mm violation and collapses the hump (ifac: reach 5.00 -> 1.24 m, +1.62 s/lap, curvlim exceeded). Spent out of reopt_wall_margin.

arg.name: use_hokuyo
arg.description: (real) start the Hokuyo urg_node; see low_level.launch

arg.name: use_livox
arg.description: (real) start the Livox MID-360 driver; see low_level.launch
